title: Which of these four names cannot belong to the square?
description: A square with corners S, P, Q and R is walked round its edge. Four names are tested with the rule that letters side by side must be the ends of a side. Keeko raises the doubt that none of the names can be wrong.
teaching_notes: One idea: a name for a shape lists its corners in order going round. Watch for children who accept a name that jumps across the middle along a diagonal.

source: Which of the following is not a name for this square? The square has corners S (top left), P (top right), Q (bottom right) and R (bottom left). 1. PQSR 2. SPQR 3. RSPQ 4. QRSP
video_script.why: The child applies the rule that neighbouring letters are the ends of a side to find the one name that jumps across the middle.
video_script.substitution: A square with corners S, P, Q and R and four given names.
video_script.anchor: A square with S at the top left, P at the top right, Q at the bottom right and R at the bottom left, and four names under it
video_script.wrong_answer: none of them can be wrong
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko thinks none of the names can be wrong, because all four use the same four letters. The name PQSR goes from Q to S across the middle, which is a diagonal and not a side, so the bubble is struck.
video_script.payoff_line: The name P Q S R is not allowed for this square.

final_answer.spoken: the name P Q S R is not allowed for this square

never_show: the verdict on the names before the answer
maths_rules: Square with S top left, P top right, Q bottom right, R bottom left; the sides are SP, PQ, QR, RS.
Going round, the corners come in the order S, P, Q, R.
SPQR: SP, PQ, QR are all sides, so it is a name. RSPQ: RS, SP, PQ are all sides. QRSP: QR, RS, SP are all sides.
PQSR: PQ is a side, but Q and S are opposite corners, so QS is a diagonal; it is not a name.
A diagonal is longer than a side, which a ruler shows.
video_script.design: One idea: neighbouring letters in a name are the ends of a side. Uses the rule of the rectangle. Wrong idea: all four names are fine because they use the same letters. The square stays all video.
